scope: Reanalysis of publicly deposited industrial-derived daily indicators; not raw SCADA reconstruction, diagnostic ground truth, or operational CIP control.
development: training label day < 450; validation origin >= 450 and label day < 550
rolling_fit_rule: Every training target is observed strictly before the test-block start. Fixed model specifications; no test tuning.
held_out_train_test: For each of A/B/C, fit other two trains using target day < 550; test held-out train at origins >= 550. No held-out train rows in fitted preprocessors or models.
pair_rule: Exact observed t+h label only; exclude pairs with CIP at t or between t and t+h inclusive. This is a conditional no-intervening-cleaning retrospective benchmark, not a policy forecast.
history_rule: Use only observed rows <= origin day after most recent known CIP; no interpolation, future imputation, or future-aware metadata.

methods.median3_7d: median of latest up to 3 observed rows in trailing 7 calendar days, no CIP crossing

candidate_gate: A model is only a promising candidate if pooled rolling MAE improves by >=5%, improvement is positive in >=3 of 4 blocks, and held-out-train pooled MAE improves by >=5%. This gate is a research screen, not operational acceptance.
unit: dimensionless published indicator units; multiply MAE by 100 only to express points on the deposited 0–1 score, not percent physical pressure or general accuracy
source_semantic_limit: Deposit dictionary says fixed-baseline deviations, while deposited scripts distinguish per-CIP dp_pct/ndp_pct from fixed-baseline DP_norm. Keep exact deposited labels; do not assign raw pressure or energy semantics. Upstream derivation cannot be audited without withheld raw data.
